content:
Here is a sample delay courier template:

[Company Logo]

Delay Notification

Dear [Customer Name],

We regret to inform you that your package with tracking number [Tracking Number] has been delayed in transit.

The expected delivery date has been revised to [New Delivery Date]. This delay is due to [Reason for Delay, e.g. inclement weather, transportation issues, etc.].

We understand the importance of your shipment and are working diligently to ensure it reaches you as soon as possible. Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this delay may have caused.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team at [Phone Number] or [Email Address].

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]

Please feel free to customize this template as needed to fit your specific situation and communication preferences. The key elements to include are the tracking number, revised delivery date, reason for the delay, and your contact information for the customer.
